correctness.rationale: The group acts on the full binary cube before its orbits are intersected with the factor set. Deficiency one is equivalent to merging exactly one unordered pair; if a group merges just that pair, the cyclic subgroup generated by an element taking one factor to the other also merges just that pair. Thus an exhaustive generator test suffices. An independent extraction used t[8h+r]=t[h] XOR t[r] with 0≤r<8: every factor through length eight meets at most two aligned blocks, whose four types all occur at h=0,1,2,5. The resulting sizes were 4,10,16,22 at lengths 2,4,6,8. For every generator at lengths 2,4,6, the independent replay iterated bitmask images until return and counted distinct unordered factor pairs sharing an ambient orbit. The counts of generators with exactly one pair were 1,0,0 among 2,24,720. At length eight the stated permutation squares to the identity and merges only 01001011 with 10110100, giving 21 classes. Replay: python3 /workspace/review-replay.py 4. No claim at other even lengths or about the full attainable spectra is certified here.
